assembly.operation: multiply each exact fixed-point coefficient by each raw QQ coefficient

assembly.source_term_index: ordinal within the original pair component, not a strata basis ID
assembly.sum: uncollected sum over fixed loci, then all nine ordered lambda pairs
assembly.term_count: inherited count of ordered lambda-pair records, not raw graph occurrences
